question_text: ABC is an equilateral triangle with sides $10\text{ cm}$ long. P is a point within the triangle. P is $7\text{ cm}$ from A and $4\text{ cm}$ from B.

subparts.stem: Draw a diagram clearly showing all of the information provided.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correctly drawn and labeled triangle showing sides 10 cm, 7 cm, and segment 4 cm with point P

subparts.solution: [Diagram of equilateral triangle ABC with point P on BC such that BP = 4 cm, AP = 7 cm, AB = AC = 10 cm]

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Drawing a clear diagram with all given lengths labeled is essential for solving geometric problems.
step_by_step: Place point P on side BC.
Label lengths: $AB = 10\text{ cm}$, $AP = 7\text{ cm}$, $BP = 4\text{ cm}$, and side of equilateral triangle $AC = 10\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Misplacing point P on the wrong triangle side.

mark_breakdown.desc: Use cosine rule in triangle ABP to find cos(BAP)
Calculate angle BAP to obtain approximately 18.2°

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The cosine rule for an angle is $\cos A = \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}$.
step_by_step: In triangle ABP, side lengths are $AB = 10$, $AP = 7$, and $BP = 4$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Subtracting the wrong side squared in the numerator.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Each internal angle of an equilateral triangle is $60^{\circ}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Using the rounded value rather than unrounded intermediate value, potentially causing minor precision differences.

mark_breakdown.desc: Apply cosine rule in triangle APC to find CP^2
Evaluate square root to obtain CP approximately 6.68 cm

subparts.solution:
By the cosine rule in $\Delta \text{APC}$:
$$\text{CP}^2 \approx 10^2 + 7^2 - 2(10)(7)\cos 41.8^{\circ}$$
$$\therefore \text{CP} \approx \sqrt{10^2 + 7^2 - 2(10)(7)\cos 41.8^{\circ}}$$
$$\therefore \text{CP} \approx 6.68\text{ cm}$$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The cosine rule states $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$.
step_by_step: In triangle APC, sides $AC = 10$, $AP = 7$, and the included angle is $\text{C}\hat{\text{A}}\text{P} \approx 41.8^{\circ}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Forgetting to take the square root at the end.
